actions: Renamed 4 broken #audio-data fragment links in appendix-g sections g.1-g.4 to point at #20-0-1-the-bipartite-taxonomy (the actual existing id in section-20.0.html).
Ran scripts/build_math_png_cache.py: rendered 220 PNGs that were declared in .book-update/math-manifest.json but missing from the cache (these were the source of the 93 LIVE-MATHML warnings).

Rendered the 3 stragglers that survived iteration 1 (likely a transient Playwright timing issue in the first render pass): keys e787306ea142252f, e795a315350ab99a, 30e92e1335cbb31b - all `\begin{aligned}` blocks with `\Big(` and column-alignment ampersands.

config_notes.math_pipeline: html2pub.toml [math] uses render=katex + png_cache=.book-update/math-png-cache + bundle_css=false. Pipeline: KaTeX renders each $..$ to MathML inline, build emits a manifest, scripts/build_math_png_cache.py renders missing entries via Playwright + KaTeX-on-Chromium at 3x DPI, and the next build's replace_mathml_with_png swaps every wrapper for an with explicit width/height + alt text. Caching means subsequent builds skip the renderer.
config_notes.audit_quality_root_cause: The 93 warnings and 4 errors were latent: the manifest grew over the last edit cycle but nobody re-ran scripts/build_math_png_cache.py, so 220 new equations stayed as live MathML in the EPUB and 4 audio-data cross-refs were left dangling when section-20.0 was renumbered.
